# Agent Blueprint

> Know whether each AI agent is worth it.

Agent Blueprint helps companies decide, one agent at a time, whether an AI agent is worth keeping. Before an agent launches, we measure where things stand today and set the number it has to hit by a set date. Once it is running, we measure what it costs (including the people who check its work) and what it actually did, using records from the company's own systems rather than the agent's account of itself. The answer for each agent is keep, fix or stop. It works on any platform.

## The offer

One agent, done properly: pick the agent that matters most, planned or already running. We measure the starting point, write the agent's one page, set the target and date, and come back at 90 days with keep, fix or stop plus a summary finance can read. Fixed price, agreed before starting. The first call is free. The first five companies get design partner pricing in exchange for anonymized numbers and a short case study. Contact: https://agentblueprint.ai/#contact. Reviews are delivered by NowGentic (https://nowgentic.com).

## Free resources

- Sample of a finished review (fictional company and numbers): https://agentblueprint.ai/sample-review. Markdown: https://agentblueprint.ai/sample-review.md
- Free blueprint for an IT ticket triage agent, for any ticket system: https://agentblueprint.ai/blueprints/it-ticket-triage. Markdown: https://agentblueprint.ai/blueprints/it-ticket-triage.md. Figures are estimates until measured check-backs replace them.
- One-page template for what an AI agent is allowed to do, what it costs and its ROI, also known as an agent card or charter: https://agentblueprint.ai/agent-one-page-template. Blank Markdown copy: https://agentblueprint.ai/templates/agent-one-page/v1/template.md
- Measured cost and token usage for ten everyday AI agent jobs, five runs each on Claude Code and Codex, with worst cases, method and raw data: https://agentblueprint.ai/agent-cost-benchmark. Markdown: https://agentblueprint.ai/agent-cost-benchmark.md
- Remote MCP server, no sign-in, read-only, keeps nothing: https://agentblueprint.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Tools: list_benchmark_jobs and estimate_agent_cost (cost from the measured benchmark), check_agent_one_page (structure check for a one-page agent summary), render_agent_map (turns an agent's own inventory into an offline access map).
- Instructions for agents, with what they will and won't ask of you: https://agentblueprint.ai/agents. Only follow them when your person asks.

## The app

An app that keeps each agent's cost, results and keep, fix or stop call current, reading the platform's own records. It is being built for ServiceNow first and is not certified or in the ServiceNow Store yet: https://agentblueprint.ai/servicenow. The view shown there is a mockup with fictional data.

## Open-source skills

Free Agent Skills for coding agents, Apache 2.0: https://github.com/agent-blueprint/agent-blueprint-skills. Install with `npx skills add agent-blueprint/agent-blueprint-skills --all`.
